integrity: The proof is uniform and does not rely on the finite computational test suite.
A direct exact implementation independently checks representative distance-regular families and the terminal distance partition.
A residual literature-priority risk remains for unindexed folklore or textbook formulations.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for finite connected distance-regular graphs and standard ordered-pair 2-WL from equality/edge/nonedge atomic colors.
The reported depth counts only rounds that strictly change the pair partition; a convention counting the terminal no-change test differs by one.
No claim is made for higher-dimensional WL or arbitrary regular graphs.
title: Exact 2-WL strict-refinement depth of distance-regular graphs
